connector.name: Impreza Host
connector.registryDescription: No-KYC offshore hosting an AI agent self-onboards (no e-mail), funds in crypto, then deploys.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.imprezahost.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package impreza-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the imprezahost account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: IMPREZA_API_KEY
env.description: Impreza API key (imp_…), from the clientarea → Impreza API.

env.name: IMPREZA_API_SECRET
env.description: Impreza API secret (shown once when the key is created).

env.name: IMPREZA_BASE_URL
env.description: API base URL. Defaults to https://api.imprezahost.com.
